text: 66 1. Practise the following conversation. A Walk in Nature 4.4 For the Teacher : • Ask the children to observe the picture. • Read the conversation loudly. • Help the children to complete the conversation using describing words. I love green forest. Can you see some animals? That fox is cute. Then why do we call it a sly animal? Oh! I can see two furry rabbits near the bush. Oh my God! That is a scary snake. Can you say something about the animals you see in the picture? Look at that slow tortoise. 2. Read and write. nature forest tortoise sly cute bush scary snake
